title: WarpBot tools
subtitle: What WarpBot can do in this workspace, and how to ask for it.

row.hostOnly: Meeting host only. Anyone can ask, but only the meeting's host can share its minutes.
row.platformOnly: Visible to WarpTalk platform staff only.
row.noMoreDetails: No more details for this tool yet.

builtIn.title: Built in
builtIn.description: Tools WarpBot uses on its own when your question needs them.
builtIn.empty: No built-in tools match your search.
builtIn.unavailableDescription: WarpBot could not report its built-in tools just now. They still work in chat; try this page again in a few minutes.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.description: Answers from the public web, with links to the sources.
webSearch.name: Search the web
webSearch.rowDescription: Looks things up on the public web and cites the pages it used.
webSearch.unknownNote: Available when your workspace allows it. When WarpBot searches the web, its answer says so and links the pages.
webSearch.empty: Web search does not match your search.
webSearch.onNote: On in this workspace. When WarpBot searches the web, its answer says so and links the pages.
webSearch.offNote: Turned off by a WarpTalk setting right now, so WarpBot answers without searching the web.
webSearch.unavailableNote: Web search is not set up for WarpBot on this WarpTalk deployment.
